prompt: Furnace Ferryman, a stout chibi boss ferryman with a very large head, wearing a wide conical straw hat with a dark soot-blackened brim, a charcoal-grey robe with glowing orange-red ember cracks along the hem, broad shoulders. He grips ONE very long wooden paddle with a flat broad iron-banded blade in his RIGHT hand, the paddle held upright beside his body, blade end glowing orange like a hot furnace plate. His left hand is empty at his side. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.
